# Look: Broadsheet

> Lede 0.8.0's docs for Look: Broadsheet, installed with it. Setup, and every item in the release: [README.md](README.md). Online: https://lede.cloudcompute.com/reference/look-broadsheet.md

A newspaper page: a reading serif, a grotesque for the paper’s own voice, ink on newsprint and rules instead of boxes. A look over Lede's components: import `styles/lede/looks/broadsheet.css` after Lede's index.css, then set `<ThemeProvider look="broadsheet">` (or `data-look="broadsheet"` on a theme root). High contrast keeps Lede's -hc palette, and an accent picked on a provider still replaces the look's.

Experimental: its props can change in a minor release, which the CHANGELOG names. An item is experimental for the release that adds it, and stable once a release ships it unchanged.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @lede/look-broadsheet
```

The command needs Lede's registry in `components.json`, as [README.md](README.md#use-it-in-a-shadcn-project) shows. It also installs the items [`lede-theme`](lede-theme.md) and [`theme-provider`](theme-provider.md), and the npm packages `@fontsource-variable/newsreader@5.3.0`, `@fontsource-variable/libre-franklin@5.3.0` and `@fontsource/unifrakturmaguntia@5.3.0`. The item's JSON, with each file's source, is https://lede.cloudcompute.com/r/v0.8.0/look-broadsheet.json.
